comparison_convention: Sky3D F00=r^2/sqrt(4pi) strength is multiplied by 4pi to match the experimental O_IS0=sum_i r_i^2 convention; no fitted normalization or energy shift.
experimental_data_classification: digitized from author arXiv vector figure
interpretation: TDHF reproduces a separated low-energy component and a higher-energy main monopole structure, but the dominant TDHF MQC peak is about 2.43 MeV above the 13.75-MeV experimental maximum bin and its low-energy strength is too concentrated.
